question: As of October 3, 2026, for each of five U.S. homebuilders (Lennar, KB Home, Toll Brothers, D.R. Horton and PulteGroup), identify the most recent reported fiscal quarter (the company's own fiscal quarter label, e.g. 'Q3 FY2026', plus the quarter-end date) and compute year-over-year growth in total revenues (%) for that quarter versus the same fiscal quarter a year earlier. Use total consolidated revenues as reported in each company's SEC filings.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Homebuilders, latest reported quarter as of 2026-10-03:
| Company | Most recent reported quarter | YoY total revenue growth |
|---|---|---|
| Lennar Corporation | Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026) | -8.67% |
| KB Home | Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026) | -19.96% |
| Toll Brothers | Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended Jul 31, 2026) | -9.72% |
| D.R. Horton | Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026) | 0.02% |
| PulteGroup | Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026) | -9.56% |

# Homebuilder Revenue Tracker — Most Recent Reported Fiscal Quarter (as of Oct 3, 2026)

| Company | Most Recent Reported Quarter | Quarter-End Date | Total Revenues (Current Yr) | Total Revenues (Prior-Yr Same Qtr) | YoY Growth |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Lennar (LEN)** | Q3 FY2026 | Aug 31, 2026 | $8,046.1M | $8,810.3M | **‑8.7%** |
| **KB Home (KBH)** | Q3 FY2026 | Aug 31, 2026 | $1,297.1M | $1,620.5M | **‑20.0%** |
| **Toll Brothers (TOL)** | Q3 FY2026 | July 31, 2026 | $2,658.8M | $2,945.1M | **‑9.7%** |
| **D.R. Horton (DHI)** | Q3 FY2026 | June 30, 2026 | $9,227.1M | $9,225.7M | **+0.0%** |
| **PulteGroup (PHM)** | Q2 2026 | June 30, 2026 | $3,983.0M | $4,403.8M | **‑9.6%** |

**Calculation notes:**
- **Lennar:** ($8,046.119M − $8,810.278M) / $8,810.278M = **‑8.67%** (−8.6% as reported by the company).
- **KB Home:** ($1,297.101M − $1,620.474M) / $1,620.474M = **‑19.96%** (~‑20%).
- **Toll Brothers:** ($2,658.781M − $2,945.117M) / $2,945.117M = **‑9.72%** (‑9.7%).
- **D.R. Horton:** ($9,227.1M − $9,225.7M) / $9,225.7M = **+0.02%** (essentially flat; company called revenues "essentially unchanged").
- **PulteGroup:** ($3,982.957M − $4,403.755M) / $4,403.755M = **‑9.55%** (‑9.6%).

**Timing notes:** PulteGroup was the only one of the five whose most recent report was *not* a Q3 — its Q3 FY2026 release is scheduled for Oct 22, 2026, so Q2 2026 (ended June 30) remains the latest. D.R. Horton's fiscal Q3 also ended June 30 (fiscal year ends Sept 30). Lennar and KB Home both have Nov 30 fiscal-year ends; Toll Brothers has an Oct 31 fiscal-year end. All figures are total consolidated revenues per each company's SEC-filed earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1).
